scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,superadmin,patient -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev:superadmin" "npm run dev:patient-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build:superadmin && npm run build:patient-web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint:superadmin
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w backend && npm run lint:fix -w frontend && npm --prefix frontend/superadmin run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm run format -w backend && npm run format -w frontend && npm --prefix frontend/superadmin run format
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm --prefix frontend/superadmin run typecheck
